strings: !This program cannot be run in DOS mode.
,Enable or disable accept tabs in RichTextBox
&Get Or set plain text of rich-text box
$Get Or set RTF text of rich-text box
WGets or sets the title text that will be displayed in the white portion above the step.
]Gets or sets the description text that will be displayed in the white portion above the step.
+Gets or sets the custom logo for this step.
DGets or sets the image to display in the sidebar for exterior pages.
?Gets or sets whether this step can be cancelled/closed by user.
QGets or sets the image that is displayed in the upper-right corner of the wizard.
hGets or sets the image that is displayed along the left side of the wizard, seen only on Exterior pages.
FAllows you to switch the design-time view from page layout to another.
,Fired when the StepLogo property has changed
-Fired when the NextStep property has changed.
1Fired when the PreviousStep property has changed.
3Fired when the CanBeCancelled property has changed.
.Fired when the StepLayout property has changed
tFired when the step needs to reset itself, this is fired when the wizard is reset and when the wizard is first shown
0Fired every time the step is shown in the wizard
0Fired when the SideBarImage property has changed
-Fired when the StepTitle property has changed
3Fired when the StepDescription property has changed
"Fired when moving to the next step
